scope: RC04/RC26/RC40; one explicit recovery consumes sequential authenticated bounded continuation results, Anonymous label and private-view feedback.

independentFocusedBrowser.command: TMPDIR=/private/tmp NODE_BACKEND=js <pinned Node24> --test --test-concurrency=1 --test-name-pattern='one explicit recovery|anonymous reply review|account invalidation during preference|preference head failure|explicit recovery abort|locking clears recovered|every preference and read marker|account invalidation synchronously|notification partial recovery' apps/rolling/wallet-panel.browser.test.mjs apps/rolling/reader.browser.test.mjs

checks.sourceBinding: Clean exact candidate; diff --check passed; only three assigned presentation/test paths changed.

review: Read changed source/tests before implementer outputs. Each continuation awaits the existing readColdPreferences call; only recovering/complete:false continues. Errors and invalid states exit to existing failure path, without retry loop or fallback. No sleeps, clock progress, assumed completion or new reader/harness.

Inspected actual wallet-session and cold-preference-reader boundaries. Session holds the original account lock for each pending read; reader authenticates and persists internal cursor/epoch/sequence/nextLog, canonical fences and completion. Its display summary omits nextLog, so equal visible progress cannot establish a stall; the test correctly requires continuation through equal summaries.

Only complete:true/status:complete publishes preferences. Start/abort/invalidation clears capability; after every settled read, captured account epoch and abort signal are checked before progress or publication. One AbortController remains until finally; busy remains owned by work until original pending read settles. Tests assert no additional reads after abort/invalidation and no stale complete publication.

Partial renders preserve enabled Stop control and its keyboard focus while disabling ordinary controls. Updated reader fixtures hold the next in-flight call and verify zero incomplete private feed/public personalized paging, not removed privacy assertions.

Anonymous label is limited to validated numeric name zero. Reopening without a saved intent clears obsolete operation feedback; when intent exists, open preserves it and its recovery state. Existing fee-confirmation and named/private preference behavior assertions remain.
limitations: Nine selected labelled browser tests establish presentation/continuation boundaries; no new live cold recovery or real-proof acceptance is claimed. Lead can exercise the retained running environment after integration.
No build, service restart, chain action or private account/key file access. Remaining product/release gates stay open.
